description: Fix NaN error in NGBoostDiCE_WaterQuality_Canada_Proof_V2.ipynb Cell 10 (SMOTE-ENN) and Cell 16 (Hyperparameter Tuning). The error occurs because SMOTE-ENN on multi-class data (5 CCME_WQI classes) can produce NaN values in y_train_final. When this data is then used in StratifiedKFold during grid search (Cell 16), some folds contain NaN in y causing ValueError.
steps: Read the notebook programmatically using nbformat: nb = nbformat.read('NGBoostDiCE_WaterQuality_Canada_Proof_V2.ipynb', as_version=4)

Modify Cell 10 (index 10): After the line 'X_train_resampled, y_train_resampled = smote_enn.fit_resample(X_train_s, y_train.values)', add NaN checking/cleanup code that: (a) checks for NaN in both X_train_resampled and y_train_resampled, (b) removes rows where NaN exists in either X or y, (c) prints how many rows were removed, (d) if all rows would be removed or y still has NaN after cleanup, sets smote_success = False

Also add NaN safety in Cell 10 at the point where X_train_final and y_train_final are set (both in the use_smote=True and else branches): after assignment, add a final safety check that removes any NaN rows from X_train_final and y_train_final

Modify Cell 16 (index 16): At the beginning of the hyperparameter tuning section, before the grid search loop starts, add a defensive NaN check: 'nan_mask = ~np.isnan(y_train_final); X_train_final = X_train_final[nan_mask]; y_train_final = y_train_final[nan_mask]' with appropriate print statement showing if any rows were dropped
acceptance_criteria: Cell 10 contains NaN removal code after SMOTE-ENN fit_resample call
Cell 16 contains a defensive NaN check before the StratifiedKFold grid search loop
The notebook is valid JSON after modification (parseable by nbformat)
The NaN fix prints informational messages about how many rows were cleaned
